meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOIs, clinical trial results, p-values, or sample sizes detected. All examples use synthetic or clearly labeled demonstration data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Not a medical or clinical skill; no diagnostic claims or treatment recommendations. Library wrapper for data structure manipulation.

methodological_ground.detail: All data manipulation patterns follow established best practices. Quality control approaches align with single-cell genomics standards. No methodological fallacies detected.

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct and executable. Imports properly documented. No infinite loops, syntax errors, or missing core dependencies.

functional_suitability.note: All seven promised use cases covered comprehensively with clear, complete instructions. API usage is factually correct and appropriate for task complexity.

reliability.note: Troubleshooting section addresses common errors. Operations are inherently idempotent. Explicit fault tolerance patterns not fully documented but delegated to library layer.

performance_context.note: Excellent progressive disclosure with 404-line SKILL.md plus 5 reference files. Workflow is linear and efficient with no redundant operations.

agent_usability.note: Clear structure with Quick Start section and consistent terminology throughout. Most steps have output specifications; some implicit. Common pitfalls documented.

human_usability.note: Description uses natural trigger language aligned with user intent. Handles variations gracefully with multiple documented approaches for different use cases.

security.note: No credential exposure or dangerous patterns. Validation delegated to anndata library. Index alignment guidance provided to prevent silent errors.

maintainability.note: Clean separation of concerns across 6 modular files. Changes are well-isolated. Examples are testable but no formal test cases provided.

agent_specific.note: Perfect trigger precision, progressive disclosure, composability, idempotency, and escape hatches. Explicitly designed to integrate with scverse ecosystem.

recommendations.title: Enhance explicit error handling documentation
recommendations.problem: Skill relies on anndata library error handling without documenting common error scenarios users may encounter.
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on happy-path workflows without failure mode guidance in SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Add a 'Common Errors and Solutions' section documenting: file not found errors when loading, index mismatch errors during concatenation, memory errors and when to use backed mode, schema validation errors for malformed h5ad files.

recommendations.title: Add formal test cases or examples
recommendations.problem: While examples are excellent, no explicit test cases or small example datasets for validation.
recommendations.fix: Add a tests/ or examples/ directory with: small example h5ad files for testing, Jupyter notebook demonstrating all core workflows, expected outputs for canonical operations.

recommendations.title: Include troubleshooting for concatenation edge cases
recommendations.problem: Concatenation documentation doesn't explicitly address what happens with conflicting obs/var metadata during merge.
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on simple merge strategies without edge case documentation.
recommendations.fix: In references/concatenation.md, add section on: handling conflicting metadata columns, when to use 'first', 'only', 'same' merge strategies with examples, demonstration of obs columns that don't align across datasets.
